Every dir now emits a row; size from a stat-only walk, name/timestamp/type/description derived from the folder name (`YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_<description>` → daily_triage/predeploy/drill/backup).

Now `buildBackupCard(backup, source)` + `BM_SOURCES` (accent/tier badge/actions). **Actions are gated to what each backend can serve**: External `Inspect` ONLY when the backup also exists in primary (`preview_restore()` hardcodes `BACKUP_DIR` and 404s on a USB-only copy) and says why when it can't; Cloud gets no Inspect (encrypted blob) and routes Download/Delete by `file_id`; Delete always routes to the tier that owns it.
  - **Cloud recovery could not decrypt ANY real object (#5124).** ⚠️ **TWO cipher formats in Drive**: `decrypt_file()` assumed **AES-256-GCM** (its own upload format) but every object was written by the nightly host job `scripts/backup/tier_sync_gdrive.py` as **openssl `-aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2 -iter 200000 -salt`**. Added `detect_format()` (sniffs `Salted__`) + `_decrypt_openssl_cbc` (KEY32+IV16 = 48B from ONE PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 pass; note GCM uses 600k iters, openssl **200k** — not interchangeable). ⚠️ **The tier is NOT single-key**: `<run>/config/*.enc` needs **`BACKUP_CONFIG_PASSPHRASE`** (encrypted upstream by `component_config.sh`, passed through un-re-encrypted); everything else **`BACKUP_GDRIVE_PASSPHRASE`**. Use `decrypt_with_candidates()` ordered by object path.
  - **Passphrase never persisted (#5125).** `_update_env_var` writes `/app/.env` — which IS `platform_v2/.env` (identical md5), a file the container **never loads** (`env_file: .env` = ROOT, where the key sits EMPTY) — and `os.environ[k]=v` reaches only **1 of 4 gunicorn workers**, so it failed ~3 requests in 4 and vanished on restart. Now `platform_settings` key **`backup:gdrive:passphrase_hash`** (hash only), DB-first read with env fallback. `has_passphrase` = hash OR server passphrase, and `cloud/status` reports `passphrase_source` (`user`/`server`/`none`). The cloud list section no longer hides itself silently when unset.

Now `_is_ephemeral_backup` (pre-deploy/repair-bay) → **NEVER copied off-site at all** (#5128): a rolling 1-copy rule still refilled ~2.4 GB after every cleanup, and the rollback reads the **PRIMARY** copy under `/backups` (still written), so the off-site copy bought nothing. `_prune_ephemeral_external(keep=0)` still runs on each ephemeral backup to sweep strays. `_is_drill_backup` → `_prune_drills_external(keep_per_kind=1)` — **per KIND** (`database`/`critical`/`full`), because the three drills are one rehearsal per backup type, not three copies; drills DO still copy off-site, pruned **AFTER** a confirmed copy (a missing drill is missing DR evidence — never prune one to zero on a failed copy). `cloud_upload` refuses both classes outright — Drive is a 15 GB free tier that filled once. Cleanups 2026-07-22 freed **21.58 GB + 2.41 GB = 24.0 GB** (USB 32.80 → **8.81 GB**; remaining = 1 daily + 3 drills); every target verified still present on primary first.

### Repair Bay — `repair_bay`

- **Status**: ✅ enabled · **Route**: `/tools/repair-bay` · **Version**: 1.0
- **Description**: Self-healing code pipeline · Scan • Propose • Sandbox • Test • PR review • Deploy
- **Access**: role `ADMIN` · tier `staff` · no explicit perms
- **Blueprint**: `tools.repair_bay:repair_bay_bp`
- **Tags**: development, pipeline, scanning, testing, deployment, development-tools
- **Notes** (curated, survives regeneration): - **Capability**: Scan→Proposal→Sandbox→Deploy pipeline. 8 tabs: Reviews, PR Review, Repairs, Diagnose, Test Bay, Ship, QA, Pushes + ENGINEERING station. 10 route files.
- **F.O.R.G.E. cross-repo PR review (2026-06-26, PRs #1927/#1928)**: reviews PRs across archie-platform + the 4 watch-product repos. READ paths (`pr_diff_analyzer._fetch_diff` + `github_service._api_get`) use a read-only `FORGE_REVIEW_TOKEN` (all repos); WRITES/auto-merge use `GITHUB_TOKEN` (archie-platform-only). `GITHUB_REPOS` = auto-poll list. `merge_pr(pr,method,repo=None)` is repo-aware; **non-default repos are REVIEW-ONLY** (human merge — no write token granted there). Coder doc KB #275972; KB mistake #275968.
- **Review integrity — FOUR independent gates (2026-07-22, PRs #2401/#2402/#2403, ADR-001 #947, KB #283134)**: a false finding can fail at four structurally different points, and a gate at one layer **cannot** catch a failure at another (each new gate only revealed the next, because the citation was ALWAYS real). In `pr_diff_analyzer.py`: **(1) GROUNDING** — is the cited line real? (`_verify_evidence`, drop `evidence_not_in_diff`, #5009). **(2) POLARITY** — is it an ADDED line? A defect can only exist in code that survives the merge; the old gate built ONE haystack from `+` and `-` so quoting DELETED code counted as grounded (gov-watch PR #45: the diff removed `event=True`, the review flagged it as the proposed state → REQUEST CHANGES; a rerun APPROVED). `_evidence_polarity()` → `added|removed_only|absent` ('added' checked FIRST so a MODIFIED line stays grounded), drop `evidence_only_removed`. **CARVE-OUT** `_critiques_the_removal()` — "this PR removes a needed guard" is LEGITIMATE and its evidence can only be a removed line. **(3) CLAIM** — is the assertion checkable from a diff? "test added but not executed" citing a DOCSTRING; grounding+polarity both correctly pass it. `_is_unverifiable_test_execution_claim()`, drop `unverifiable_runtime_claim` (#5098). **(4) SEVERITY** — does the label match the content? "[CRITICAL] Content Verification Check Added — Ensures…" is PRAISE tagged CRITICAL. `_asserts_no_defect()` demotes to INFO in BOTH `_normalize_severity` (structured) and `_demote_nonblocking_lines` (freeform). ⚠️ Only `evidence_not_in_diff` counts toward `_count_ungrounded` / the #5009 ungrounded-APPROVE floor — a polarity error or unverifiable claim means the model WAS reading, so counting it would re-block correct PRs. Guards **demote, never drop**, where the observation still helps a human. 224 forge tests pin this. **Per `feedback_forge-no-silent-override` a REQUEST CHANGES is not a clear — disprove it IN WRITING, and NEVER merge on a MISSING verdict** (a dead review is not an approval).
- **Merge governance — THE choke point (2026-07-25, PRs #2459/#2460, tasks #5194, KB #283905/#283906)**: `github_service.merge_pr(pr_number, method='squash', repo=None, human_override=False, authority='forge')`. Every UNATTENDED merge must clear `_automerge_governance_ok()`, which requires BOTH an approved stored F.O.R.G.E. verdict AND `classify_pr_tier() <= ceiling`, and **fails CLOSED** on a missing review row / unparseable verdict / any exception. Checked **before any GitHub call**, so a refusal costs no API call and cannot race; returns `governance_blocked: True`. ⚠️ **Ceilings are PER-ACTOR** — `_AUTHORITY_CEILING = {forge: (FORGE_AUTO_MERGE_MAX_TIER, 1), coo: (ARCHIE_COO_AUTO_MERGE_MAX_TIER, 2)}`; an unknown authority falls back to the most restrictive. **Tier 3 is Kytran's and is auto-merged by nobody.** `human_override=True` is for INTERACTIVE authenticated callers ONLY (the two `@admin_required` routes; the /merge-pr skill still needs updating to pass it). **THE PRINCIPLE: safety properties are UNIVERSAL, authority limits are PER-ACTOR** — "nothing merges on a non-approval" binds every actor; "max tier 1" binds only F.O.R.G.E. ⚠️ Root cause was NOT `mark_review_done` (well defended) but a SECOND parallel path — `ai_bridge.agent_loop._run_archie_pr_review_worker` selects on `review_status='reviewed'`, which means a review FINISHED not that it APPROVED; it never called `verdict_is_approved()` and merged Tier 2 unconditionally. PR #2458 reached main on a `needs_changes` verdict that way, blocked twice beforehand ONLY by an accidental HTTP 405 "still a draft" — and since `/commit-push-pr` opens PRs NON-draft, the normal case merged on the first attempt with no failure line at all. Gate the CHOKE POINT, never per-caller: `merge_pr` has 5 call sites and per-caller gating is how the hole existed. Tests: `tests/test_merge_governance_gate.py` (20).
- **Merge governance — the SAFETY half is now ONE function (2026-08-20, PRs #2722/#2724, ADR-018)**: `github_service.verdict_refusal(summary, verdict_ok, coverage_ack=False)` is the single definition consumed by the Approvals tab (`agent_loop.tab_merge_refusal` delegates to it) AND both `@admin_required` routes (`github_routes.forge_merge_pr`, `forge_pr_review_merge`). ⚠️ Before #2722 those two routes had **NO verdict check at all** — the same PR the tab refused could be merged from the Repair Bay UI on a `needs_changes` verdict. It deliberately does **NOT** re-impose the allowlist or tier ceiling: those are AUTHORITY limits and an authenticated human clicking Merge is the authority they exist to require (decision #953). Staleness stays with `merge_pr`'s `_override_stale_verdict_check` (#5672), binding every actor.
- **COVERAGE DISCHARGE (#2724)**: the #5836 gate rewrites the final verdict to `NEEDS REVIEW`, and `parse_verdict` reads the LAST verdict — so an APPROVE and a REJECT were indistinguishable and every coverage-demoted PR needed the CLI. `pr_review_service.coverage_only_demotion(summary)` re-parses the model's **ORIGINAL** verdict (everything before `MARKER`, since `annotate()` builds `f"{summary}\n\n{block}"`), and `coverage_dropped_paths(summary)` names the files. Both merge routes accept `{"coverage_ack": true}` and return **422** `{success:false, merged:false, error, coverage_only, dropped_files[]}` on refusal; the UI confirm NAMES the dropped files. ⚠️ **A REQUEST CHANGES that ALSO got coverage-demoted stays refused even WITH the ack** — an ack is consent to unread files, never consent to a defect (`test_ack_does_NOT_clear_a_real_rejection`). Fails CLOSED on any exception.
- **Chunked multi-pass PR review + attempt history (2026-08-20, PRs #2729/#2731/#2732/#2733, #5848/#5859/#5852)** — `_obtain_review_summary` can split a diff into up to 3 SERIAL passes via `review_coverage.chunk_plan()` and fold them with `_merge_chunk_summaries()` (verdict LATTICE APPROVE < NEEDS REVIEW < REQUEST CHANGES; findings deduped; a lost or unparseable pass fails CLOSED to NEEDS REVIEW). `ground_diff` is ALWAYS the FULL diff — only what the MODEL SEES is chunked. Whole-PR Dockerfile provenance (#4749) runs ONCE, attached to chunk 0. ⚠️ Coverage is the UNION of chunks joined with a **NEWLINE** — `"".join` glues a mid-line truncation onto the next `diff --git` header and a REVIEWED file reads as DROPPED (KB #292200). ⚠️ The `[review-meta]` path marker is carried forward WEAKEST-WINS via `_classify_review_path`; a marker-less summary reads as "legacy — the degraded path" and ALARMS `check_review_path_health` (decision #1008). **Killswitch `platform_settings forge:review_max_chunks` — default/absent = 1 = byte-identical pre-chunking. Currently OFF: flipped to 3 on 2026-08-20 and ROLLED BACK the same day (see #5861).** NEW `pr_review_service.record_review_attempt()` appends every attempt to `forge_reviews` (previously 0 rows — its only writers were in the never-fired `POST /api/forge/webhook`); `attempt_number` derived inside the INSERT; repo/head_sha/verdict/severities in `raw_payload` since the table has no repo column; ⚠️ its `created_at` is `timestamp WITHOUT time zone`. NOT shipped: the plan's union ungrounded floor is UNREACHABLE with the per-chunk #5009 floor retained.
- ⚠️ **The Merge button lies about state** — it renders unconditionally green/enabled for every open PR, and the badge shows `review_status`, whose green `reviewed` is identical for APPROVE, REQUEST CHANGES and a coverage demotion. You learn the real state by clicking. Spec + task: **#5853**, `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-20-merge-state-ui-design.md`.
- **Ship tab**: `GET /api/deploy/website-status`, `POST /api/deploy/website-trigger`. Results in `system_config` keys `website_deploy_last_run_<domain>` / `website_deploy_last_status_<domain>`.
- **Deploy Provenance sub-tab (Ship tab, #4777/#4749, PR #2148, ADR decision #903)**: per-product drift matrix (green/red/gray = in_sync/drift/fail_open) of each image-baked product's running BAKED `/version` SHA vs its source-path head. `GET /api/deploy/provenance` (`@admin_required`) → `{ok, checked_at, products:[{product,url,baked_sha,expected_sha,status}], in_sync_count, drift_count, fail_open_count}`; reuses `scripts/deploy_drift_check.py:check_products()` (the SAME path-aware GitHub-API compare as the daily `deploy_drift_monitor` job + F.O.R.G.E. Dockerfile guard — single source of truth), ~2-min in-process cache, fail-safe. Frontend `loadDeployProvenance()` (XSS-safe, `dp-` classes). Covers all 9 products (media_hub/kbs/kso/wtf_consumer/wtf_tech/gov/market/legal/civic). Rule: `deploy-provenance.md`.
- **CRITICAL**: Hostinger `POST /api/hosting/v1/websites/{username}/deploy` → **404**. Only working path: `/deploy-website` skill via `mcp__hostinger-api__hosting_deployStaticWebsite`. KB #261679.

Reads the live graph, no new ingest. **Municipal** `/municipal` (#3330, PR #1918) = `beat='municipal'` (NOT geo_scope). ⚠️ `shared.entities` is IMMUTABLE — `entities_guard()` forbids DELETE; retire via `status='suppressed'`. Product→graph adapters POST `wtf-ingest-api:8106/api/internal/entity-graph/ingest` + read the TMX company set via `GET /api/internal/entity-graph/companies` (#3059, PR #1926). **Legal #3059 competition→company linking LIVE** (legal-watch `--source competition` → `competition_enforcement` mentions via slug POINTERS; surfaced as the free "Named in Competition Bureau items" section on `/entity/<id>`). Market #4471 entity build-up still pending (upstream data). Coder docs KB #275529; user KB #275528.
- **A.U.R.O.R.A. weather (project #393, 2026-08-18, PRs #2675–#2685 — LIVE)**: `/weather` now carries REAL environmental data, not just climate-beat articles. Phase 1 = CWFIS wildfire/hotspot/fire-weather (385 **Canadian** stations); Phase 2 = MSC Datamart city observations + forecasts, **25 cities covering all 13 provinces & territories**, hourly. Tables `wtf.aurora_firewx_obs` / `_fire_hotspot_daily` / `_fire_perimeters` / `_city_site` / `_city_obs` / `_city_forecast` (migrations 053, 055). Ingest `ingest/weather/{cwfis,citypage}.py` (both never raise; heartbeat to `parliament.ingest_log` on success, exception AND swallowed-error paths; both registered in `drift_guard._MAX_AGE_DAYS` *and* `_REQUIRED_TASKS`). Parsing is in stdlib-only `citypage_parse.py` + `consumer/aurora_map.py` so guard tests cannot silently SKIP (KB #290497).
  · **`wtf.aurora_layer_status` is the ONLY source of source names** — templates LOOP it. Hardcoding one is how the page advertised "Environment Canada + NASA + NOAA" while holding no weather data (KB #290491). The view gained **`stale_after_hours`** (city_obs **3h**, city_forecast 12h, fire 48h) — the old hardcoded 48h let a 40-hour-old "current condition" render as fresh.
  · ⚠️ **ADR-001**: `dd.weather.gc.ca` ONLY. `api.weather.gc.ca/collections/*/items` is robots-disallowed; **`dd.alpha.weather.gc.ca` is `Disallow: /`**. Path is `/{YYYYMMDD}/WXO-DD/citypage_weather/{PROV}/{HH}/` — the **dated** form (today/ flips at 00:00Z), `WXO-DD` mandatory, no `xml/` segment, filenames NOT constructible (list the hour dir, take max()). `siteList.xml` is **ISO-8859-1**, not UTF-8. Full detail KB #290553 / **#290573 (correction)**.
  · 🔴 **FIVE encodings of absence**, and forecast **`<gust>00</gust>` means NO GUST while parsing cleanly as `0`** — it hit **290 of 310** live forecast periods, so `int(x or 0)` would fabricate a measurement on 94% of them. `<speed>calm</speed>` is a MEASUREMENT (own `wind_is_calm` column), not absence. Station coords are hemisphere-SUFFIXED strings (`"79.63W"`) — `float()` raises, stripping the letter puts Canada in Asia.
  · 🔑 **The two fire layers cover DISJOINT halves of Canada** (stations east, hotspots west/north), so a single choropleth is a lie either way: the map switches layers and greys uncovered provinces explicitly. KB #290498.
  · **Province codes: CWFIS emits `NF`, Datamart emits `NL`, the GeoJSON says `NL`.** `consumer/aurora_map._canon_prov` is the ONE canonicalisation boundary — a second one is how a province goes missing.
- **Site shell + data integrity (2026-08-18, PRs #2677–#2685)**: `/blindspot`, `/divergence`, `/economy`, `/municipal`, `/weather` were STANDALONE documents (own `<html>`, own nav, own palette) — all now extend `base.html` with namespaced classes (`wtf-bs-`/`wtf-dv-`/`wtf-ec-`/`wtf-mu-`/`wtf-wx-`); guard `tests/test_site_shell_continuity.py`. The nav "LIVE · N SOURCES" counter is ONE cached context processor (it read **0** on /lobbying and /claims and disagreed 46-vs-41 elsewhere). **Three French sources were declared `en`** (La Presse 491, Le Journal de Montréal 13765, L'actualité 13766), putting **2,785 French articles on the English side** of the public `/divergence` EN-vs-FR comparison — migration 054 corrects them, identified by CONTENT not name (Edmonton Journal matches a French-name heuristic and IS English). **La Presse was ingested via a Google News proxy** — 74/180 titles were the literal `- La Presse+`; migration 056 re-points it to `lapresse.ca/actualites/rss`, adds reversible `wtf.articles.suppressed_reason`, and `ingest/persist.is_publisher_suffix_title()` rejects publisher-only titles at ingest. ⚠️ **10 of 46 sources use a Google News feed** — migration 056 reports them all on every run; the other 9 sit at 73–98% title uniqueness vs La Presse's 43.9%.
